description: A VibeBooking hotel's published facts, with no dates needed: name, address, check-in and cancellation terms, images and its room types (rooms[].ref, name, max_occupancy, size_m2 and each room's own facts). With room, a ref from rooms[].ref, one room type's page instead. hotel is the id from search_hotels or resolve_hotel, or the hotel's domain. For a hotel that is not ours the answer is its own site's address.

hotel.description: The hotel id from search_hotels or resolve_hotel, or the hotel's website domain.

room.description: A room type's ref, from get_hotel's rooms[].ref; leave out for the whole hotel.

name: get_hotel
title: Get hotel details
